title: Miami Rent Boat
gap: Duration of private lesson not stated
blurb: Guests rent a private wake boat for up to 10 people, with the boat run by the operator. Activities include wakesurfing, wakeboarding, tubing, and swimming, with coaching and gear provided. They also offer group sessions and private lessons focused on wakesurfing.
extraNote: Pier 5 at the Venetian Marina, 1635 N Bayshore Drive in Downtown Miami; park at Herald Plaza nearby
